description: The same PIDL with its WritePrivateProfileStruct checksum byte corrupted
notes: The file parses, so the fixture expects "ok"; it is UrlFile::id_list_bytes that fails, with ErrorKind::Malformed. GetPrivateProfileStruct rejects a bad checksum too, which is why this is an error rather than a warning -- a wrong checksum usually means the value was truncated, and a truncated PIDL parses into confident nonsense.
leak_allow_reason: Same hand-built PIDL as idlist-pidl.bin with one digit changed; the hex run is the fixture, not a token.
